notes.title: Mechanized Corps: Rebirth patch 0.2.3.002 has been released!
notes.content:
This patch contains the new game mode mini nuke plus a new map Arctic Outpost!  Full change log below:

[h2]Patch 0.2.3.002 Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New game mode Mini Nuke.  A nuke drops in the map and you have to grab the nuke before anyone else and take it to the base of the enemy and detonate it.  If a nuke is deployed at your base you have to disarm it before it detonates.
[*] New Map Arctic Outpost available for skirmish and mini nuke
[*] Sector 7 now has mini nuke gameplay mode available in Instant Action and Multiplayer.
[*] AI now knows how to play mini nuke gameplay.
[*] Number of respawns now defaults to 3 on all game modes.
[*] Fixed a few bugs with tree destruction so weapon interaction with trees works better now.
[*] You can drop the nuke by pressing N (default key)
[*] Foilage/Trees was updated on Sector 7.
[*] Updated the weather and lighting on sector7, The Octagon, Badlands Arena
[*] Enemy Base Marker now hides when the deploy marker is shown on mini-nuke once you pickup the nuke.
[*] indicator icons are more visible now and changed art a bit.
[*] Fixed an issue where AI could get stuck on a building on the defender side of sector 7.
[/list]

notes.title: New Arctic Outpost map with a new build for testing mini nuke
notes.content:
We have pushed a new patch to the Beta Branch 'staging' to continue testing mini nuke before it is released.  This update includes a new map Arctic Outpost!  Full change log below:

[h2]Patch 0.2.3.001 Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated spawn points in mini nuke on sector 7 to be father back.
[*] indicator icons are more visible now and changed art a bit.
[*] tweaked settings of mini nuke (30 second deploy and 15 second disarm).
[*] Fixed an issue where AI could get stuck on a building on the defender side of sector 7.
[*] Fixed an issue where nuke can fall through terrain on rare cases and be lost forever.  If anything bad happens it will now respawn.
[*] When disarming the nuke it no longer snaps to you, if you want to pick up the nuke you have to keep standing over it til the closing animation finishes and its packed up for transport.
[*] New Map Arctic Outpost available for skirmish and mini nuke
[*] Updated the weather and lighting on Sector 7, The Octagon, Badlands Arena.
[/list]

notes.title: 🚀 Dev Update – Mini Nuke Game Mode Incoming!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It’s been a while since our last update, so we wanted to share some exciting development news with you!

[h2]🔥 New Game Mode: Mini Nuke[/h2]

We’ve been working hard on a brand-new gameplay mode called Mini Nuke. The core game type is now complete, and the AI is fully functional—but it’s still a bit buggy. We’re actively refining things and plan to release it to a larger group soon.

Before the full release, we’ll likely make it available on a pre-launch beta branch. If you’re interested in helping test it, this will be your chance to jump in early and share your feedback!

[h2]🧨 How It Works[/h2]

In the first version of Mini Nuke, each team will have one deploy site.

[list]
[*] When the match begins, a nuke spawns in the center of the map with a visible indicator icon.
[*] A player can pick up the nuke by walking over it. The nuke is stored in their mech, and their indicator changes to show they’re carrying it.
[*] Their name and distance indicator remain red or green, so teammates and enemies can still identify them at a glance.
[*] The player carrying the nuke will also see a HUD icon above their weapons display indicating the nuke is equipped.
[*] A new deploy indicator will appear, pointing to the enemy’s deploy pad.
[/list]

[h2]💣 Deploying & Disarming the Nuke[/h2]

[list]
[*] Walk over the enemy deploy pad with the nuke to arm it.
[*] A detonation countdown will appear at the top of everyone's HUD.
[*] Your team must defend the nuke, while the enemy team tries to disarm it.
[/list]

To disarm the nuke:

[list]
[*] Walk onto the deploy site and stand still.
[*] A "Disarm" message will appear below the countdown.
[*] Stay on the pad until both messages disappear — this means the nuke has been disarmed and picked up by your team.
[*] Now you can carry the nuke and attempt a deployment at the enemy base.
[/list]

If the nuke carrier is destroyed, the nuke is dropped and can be picked up by anyone.

[h2]🎯 Win Conditions[/h2]

You can win the match in one of two ways:

[list]
[*] Successfully deploy the nuke at the enemy base, triggering a nuclear explosion.
[*] Eliminate the entire enemy team.
[/list]

To emphasize the objective, the default number of respawns is now set to 3.

[h2]🤖 Play Solo or Online[/h2]

This mode is fully playable in:

[list]
[*] Instant Action vs. AI
[*] Multiplayer vs. players or a mix of players and AI
[/list]

[h2]📣 Beta Branch & Feedback[/h2]

We’ll post another announcement when Mini Nuke hits the beta branch. We’d love to hear your thoughts — on the mode itself, on balance, and especially on the AI, which now has a lot of new functionality to support this gameplay.

Thanks for your continued support! We’re excited to get this mode into your hands soon.

— X10 Game Studios

notes.title: Mechanized Corps: Rebirth 0.2.2.009 hot fix is live!
notes.content:
We found some issues with chat and loading missions from a user report that turned out had their friends list offline.  So this patch addresses the issue.  Changes listed below:

[h2]Change Log[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where steam friends being offline would break the game and not allow you to load into any matches.
[*] Fixed an issue where steam friends being offline would stop global chat working.
[*] Fixed an issue where steam being offline would prevent the full initialization of the game causing chat to not work and fail to load missions.  If you have steam offline you will not contribute towards achievements but everything else should function now.
[/list]

notes.title: Mechanized Corps: Rebirth 0.2.2.008 has been released!
notes.content:
This patch focuses around some UI/Chat changes and bug fixes that are meant to make the menus easier to use as well as see when others are online better.  Using these new changes, we hope players will be able to find MP games easier with others playing.  Change log for this patch is listed below.

Patch 0.2.2.008 Notes:
* Change main menu to have Single Player option and moved campaign and instant action under it so its clear that campaign and Instant action are single player content
* Multiplayer now defaults to 7 bots max now like Instant Action.
* Global chat now stays connected, your name changes to have -ingame when you go into a game and you now emote what you are doing when loading into a match/test range/etc.
* Added a new easier join screen for multiplayer instead of requiring the use of server list.  Server list is still available if you prefer the old way.
* Fixed a bug where the global chat and in match chats had the input limited to 45 characters.
* Fixed a bug where the bottom chat line was cut off in global chat once it started scrolling.
* Fixed the global chat user popup to read better when over news.

notes.title: Mechanized Corps: Rebirth Launches March 11th!
notes.content:
The year is 2361. Three hundred years have passed since Cold War rivalries erupted into nuclear devastation. Humanity has expanded beyond Earth, with colossal space stations orbiting planets and Mars standing as an independent power. But war never changes—governments, corporations, and mercenary factions battle to control the SOL system's dwindling resources.

In this fragile peace, disputes are settled not through diplomacy but battles between massive mechanized warriors (MCs) armed with Gatling guns, missiles, lasers, and even orbital bombardments. The question is: How long can this fragile peace last before full-scale war erupts once again?

What Awaits You in Mechanized Corps: Rebirth?
🔹 Choose Your MC – Select from four classes: Scout, Infantry, Heavy, and Assault, each with three unique chassis.
🔹 Full Customization – Equip your MC with dozens of weapons, engines, shields, cloaking devices, and more to dominate the battlefield.
🔹 Paint and Personalize – Stand out or blend in with custom paint jobs for your MC.
🔹 Battle Across Multiple Modes – Fight offline in Instant Action mode or challenge players online in squad-based warfare and arena battles.
🔹 Faction Wars & Mercenary Life – Align with a nation, corporation, or mercenary faction—or fight for your own glory!

[b][u]Current Early Access Game Features[/u][/b]
✅ Instant Action Mode – Battle AI-driven opponents with AI squadmates, perfect for solo play.
✅ Multiplayer Battles – Team up with friends against AI or fight head-to-head in online arenas.
✅ Pilot Progression – Track stats, switch faction allegiances, and build your reputation as an elite MC pilot.
✅ Squad Management – Form or join a squad to fight together in online battles.
✅ MC Hangar – Build, modify, and create the ultimate war machine with weapons, flight systems, shields, and more.

[b][u]Join the Community & Prepare for Battle![/u][/b]
Want to connect with other pilots, form squads, and stay up-to-date with game updates? Join our official Discord server today:
[url=https://discord.gg/VM9bdrtNyU]🔗 Join the Discord[/url]

[b]Mark Your Calendars – March 11, 2025![/b]
The battlefield is calling. Suit up, customize your MC, and fight for your faction, your corporation, or your own survival in Mechanized Corps: Rebirth!

notes.title: Mechanized Corps: Rebirth Demo updated to version 0.2.2.003!
notes.content:
As we ramp up for the release of Mechanized Corps: Rebirth on March 11th, we have released patch 0.2.2.003. This release has significant changes to the AI as well as some bug fixes.  Full change log below.

[h2]Change log[/h2]
[list]
[*] Upgraded AI system to a newer version of our internal system to allow for adding new AI features easier.
[*] Upgraded AI to perform better at a basic level.
[*] Updating home target to be slightly above cockpit and reduced size of rocket explosions to cut down on homing rockets blinding you in first person mode.
[*] Added a photo sensitivity warning since it can get intense being shot in cockpit mode.
[*] Removed reference to steam cloud in save text since we no longer use it.
[*] Fixed a pathing issue where AI could get stuck sometimes on the door going out of spawn bays on non sector 7 maps.
[*] Added extra AI bot pilots and squads.
[*] Fixed a bug where if you self destructed more than once before exploding it would count it as multiple deaths.
[*] Fixed issue where AI would stop sometimes.
[*] Updated AI to use Countermeasures if they have them equipped.
[*] Fixed an issue where spectator cam would clip on the mech it's following.
[/list]
